findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT: Inspector observed no soap available at the bar handwashing sink. CORRECTED- person in charge (PIC) placed hand soap at the sink, to be hung from a hook moving forward (also discussed installing a soap dispenser- as long as it is available and functional, it is in compliance with the food code). Ensure hand washing sinks are always supplied with warm running water, soap, and paper towels to allow for proper hand washing.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. [P]
